subject: Error: None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched...

messages.author: a718d60f4623162f
messages.subject: Error: None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched...
parts:
I am still getting the following error message when I try to run GGIR with a sleeplog: None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched with the ID numbers in the sleeplog. You may want to check that the ID format in your sleeplog is consistent with the ID column in the GGIR part2 csv-report, and that argument coldid is correctly set.

I am using the latest version of GGIR (3.1-4) and have restarted both R and my computer. I am using a mac, not sure if it is a mac problem?

When I open up part2_summary.csv afterwards, I noticed there was spaces after the ID number. Not sure if that is why the error is coming up. Is there an easy way to address this within the code so that we can run the whole script without having to edit each file? 

Thanks!

messages.author: 4b9dc262ec278dc5
messages.subject: Re: Error: None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched...
parts:
Hi Jessica,

How did you define the parameter idloc? See documentation here: https://wadpac.github.io/GGIR/articles/GGIRParameters.html?q=idloc#idloc

You need to make sure that the ID in your sleeplo matcher the ID extracted by GGIR.

Best,
Jairo
